intro: Old Noida takes in the first sectors at the Delhi end of the city, from Sector 14 by the Delhi border and Sectors 11 and 12, through 15, 15A, 17 and 19 to 22, on to Sectors 23 and 25 to 31 and 33. The housing shows its age: kothis and builder floors on authority plots, large RWA-run colonies of flats in Sectors 21 and 25, Noida Authority LIG and MIG flats in Sector 22, and older villages such as Nithari in Sector 31 and Chaura Raghunathpur in Sector 22. In most lanes a tutor rings a doorbell; in the managed colonies there is a gate entry first.

Reaching the door is the easy part in much of the zone. The Blue Line crosses from Delhi at New Ashok Nagar and then stops at Sector 15, Sector 16 and Sector 18 stations and at Botanical Garden, where the Magenta Line also halts, so many homes are a walk from a train. What slows tutors down is the evening build-up on the approach to the DND and at the Film City Flyover, plus crowded streets around the Sector 18 market. Heavy monsoon rain can slow evening travel here, so agree an online fallback for those evenings before the season starts.

NXTutors lists tutors for Old Noida starting with those who live in these sectors, then tutors who travel here, then others across Noida, then online tutors. Because so many homes sit near a metro station, tell us your sector, block and nearest station along with the class, board and subject, and a tutor who commutes by train becomes a realistic choice. You get two or three matched tutors and see each tutor's fee before the demo. The first class is a free demo at your home or online, and if the tutor stops suiting your child, switching later is free.
faqs: Which sectors make up Old Noida?

Sectors 11 to 33 at the Delhi end of the city, including 14A and 15A and the older sectors around the Sector 18 market, such as 17, 26, 27 and 28. Sectors 34 to 53, around Noida City Centre, form Central Noida, which has its own zone page and tutor list.
Can a tutor from Delhi reach Old Noida easily?

Often, yes. The DND Flyway lands at Sector 15A, and the Blue Line enters Noida from New Ashok Nagar at Sector 15, so a Delhi-based tutor has both a road and a metro route. Evenings on the roads towards the DND are slow, though, so a class before the rush suits such a tutor better.
What is different about tuition in Sectors 21 and 25?

Much of each sector is a managed colony of flats rather than plotted houses: Sector 21 is largely an RWA-run colony, and Sector 25 is a housing-board colony first built for armed-forces families. Expect a gate entry for the tutor, so give security the tutor's name and timings once before the first class.
Who decides a tutor's fee in Old Noida?

Each tutor sets their own hourly rate, and NXTutors shows it on your shortlist before the demo, so there are no surprises after the first class. Rates tend to rise with the class and board, and for international boards or entrance-exam work; the free demo lets you judge value before you commit.

intro: Central Noida runs from Sector 34 through Sectors 35 to 53, around Noida City Centre and the Golf Course. It is the city's big plotted belt: lettered blocks of kothis and builder floors in Sectors 36, 39, 40, 41, 46, 47 and 48, the large house blocks of Sectors 50 and 51, the gated community of Arun Vihar in Sector 37, towers and floors in Sector 45, and villages including Morna, Chhalera, Sadarpur, Baraula, Hoshiyarpur, Aghapur and Gijhore. Sector 34 alone mixes plotted blocks with authority flats and private towers, so the right entry routine depends on which block you live in.

For tutors without a car, few parts of Noida are easier. Noida City Centre station stands in Sector 39, Golf Course station serves Sectors 36 and 40, Sector 34 and Sector 52 stations sit on the Blue Line, and the Aqua Line begins at Sector 51, joined to Sector 52 on foot, before stopping at Sector 50. A metro commuter can therefore reach much of the zone and walk the last stretch. By road it is another story: Dadri Main Road and Amrapali Road jam at peak hours, and lanes in Baraula or Hoshiyarpur need clear directions and a parking spot on the first visit.

Tutors for Central Noida appear nearest first: people living in Sectors 34 to 53, then tutors who travel into them, then the rest of Noida, and online tutors last. Since metro commuters widen the pool here, say which station is closest to you, along with your block, the class, board and subject. We shortlist two or three matched tutors, and each tutor's fee is visible before you book the free demo class. Should the first choice not work out over the term, NXTutors finds another tutor for you and the switch is free.
faqs: Which sectors are in Central Noida?

Sectors 34 to 53 around Noida City Centre and the Golf Course, including 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 40, 41 and 44 to 53, and the villages inside them such as Morna, Sadarpur and Baraula. Sectors 55, 56, 61 and 62 form the separate Sector 62 belt beside the office area on NH-9.
Is it easy to find a tutor who comes by metro here?

Easier than in most of Noida. Noida City Centre, Golf Course, Sector 34 and Sector 52 on the Blue Line, and Sector 51 and Sector 50 on the Aqua Line, cover much of the zone. Sectors 46, 47 and 48 have no station inside, so tutors there usually arrive by road.
We live in a village pocket like Baraula or Morna. Will tutors come?

Yes. Tutors teach in the village areas too, but narrow lanes make the first visit harder. Send a map pin and a landmark such as the nearest market or bus stand, and agree where the tutor can park. A tutor on a two-wheeler from a neighbouring sector usually finds it easiest.
What if the demo tutor is good but the timing is not?

Tell us. The free demo is there to test both the teaching and the practical fit, and every shortlisted tutor's fee is shown beforehand. If the slot does not work, we look for another matched tutor who can keep it, and switching later in the term is also free.

intro: The Sector 62 belt is small, four sectors along NH-9, but each one houses families differently. Sector 62 is mostly cooperative group housing societies of two- and three-bedroom flats, kept apart from the office, IT and institutional blocks that make the sector well known, and it borders Indirapuram and Khoda on the Ghaziabad side. Sector 61 mixes societies, low-rise apartments, floors and houses. Sector 55 is plotted houses along Khora Road and Noida 22 Main Road, many of them long-settled family homes, and Sector 56 has Noida Authority Janta and LIG flats beside independent homes and small market booths.

Offices shape tuition timing more than distance does. Residents report congestion on NH-9 at peak hours and around the office blocks and stations, and heavy traffic with tight parking in Sector 61, so a class that starts during the office rush tends to run late. The metro softens this. Noida Sector 61 station sits inside Sector 61, Sector 62 has both its own station and the Electronic City terminus, and a tutor heading for Sectors 55 or 56 can use Sector 59 station outside them and finish by auto. Otherwise tutors come by scooter or cab.

With only four sectors in the belt, the tutor list often has to reach beyond it, so NXTutors runs it from tutors living in Sectors 55, 56, 61 and 62, to those who travel here, then tutors elsewhere in Noida, then online. Give us your sector and society, the class, board and subject, and a slot outside the office rush. You receive two or three matched tutors, each with the fee shown before you book, and the first class is a free demo. If your child needs a change later, switching tutor is free.
faqs: Which sectors are in the Sector 62 belt?

Four: Sectors 55, 56, 61 and 62, beside the office and institutional area along NH-9. Sectors 70 and 71, which border Sector 61, fall in the Sectors 70–82 zone, and tutors based there often take classes in Sector 61 as well, so check both pages.
Which time of day suits tuition near Sector 62?

A slot that stays clear of the office rush. Straight after school, or once the evening peak on NH-9 has passed, is easier for a tutor to keep than one timed as offices empty. If the tutor arrives by metro, the Noida Sector 62 or Electronic City stations take the roads out of the equation.
Do we need a gate pass for the tutor in Sector 62?

Usually. Most families in Sector 62 live in cooperative group housing societies, so the tutor passes a security gate. Share the tutor's name and class timings with the guard or society office before the demo. In Sector 55's plotted houses and many Sector 56 homes, the tutor comes straight to your door.
Are the tutors checked before they are shown to us?

Tutors who join NXTutors go through an ID check: a one-time code to confirm their phone or email, and a government photo ID that our team reviews before the profile goes live. It is an identity check, not a police check, so keep an adult at home and judge the tutor at the free demo.

intro: The Sectors 70–82 zone splits into three kinds of neighbourhood. Sectors 74, 75, 76, 77, 78 and 79 are tower country, laid out as large group-housing plots given to builders, with parks, shops and internal roads inside each cluster. Sectors 70 to 73 are lower-rise, with builder floors, independent houses, smaller societies, older Janta flats in Sector 71 and Sarfabad village across much of Sector 73. Sector 82, out on Dadri Main Road, is arranged in pockets, with cooperative societies whose homes range from EWS flats to HIG duplexes. Where you live decides whether the tutor meets a guard or a doorbell.

The Aqua Line is a tutor's friend here. Noida Sector 50 station sits at the edge of Sector 75, Noida Sector 76 has its own stop, Noida Sector 101 serves Sectors 78 and 79, and NSEZ is closest to Sector 82, so a tutor can ride in and walk to your tower. Driving is harder: Vikas Marg crawls at office hours, the Sector 71/51 crossing and the junction by Sector 101 station back up, and Vishwakarma Road is busy around Sector 71. Density helps, though: with so many families in neighbouring towers, a tutor often teaches next door already.

NXTutors shows tutors for this belt in distance order: those living in Sectors 70 to 82, then tutors who travel here, then tutors across Noida, then online. When you ask, name your sector and society, and say whether you are in a tower cluster or the low-rise sectors, along with the class, board and subject. We shortlist two or three matched tutors with fees visible upfront. The first class is a free demo, and the free switch later means you can move from a travelling tutor to one in your own society if that becomes possible.
faqs: Which sectors does the Sectors 70–82 zone cover?

Sectors 70, 71, 72 and 73 on the lower-rise side, the tower sectors 74 to 79, and Sector 82 on Dadri Main Road, near Sectors 93 and 110. Sector 61, which borders Sector 70, belongs to the Sector 62 belt, and the expressway sectors form their own zone.
Which metro stations do tutors use for this belt?

Aqua Line stations: Noida Sector 50 beside Sector 75, Noida Sector 76 inside Sector 76, Noida Sector 101 for Sectors 77 to 79, and NSEZ or Noida Sector 83 for Sector 82. For Sectors 70 to 73, a tutor usually rides to Noida Sector 51 or the Blue Line's Sector 61 and finishes by auto or e-rickshaw.
Is Sarfabad village in Sector 73 easy for a tutor to reach?

Reasonably, with some planning. Village lanes are narrow and parking is tight, so a tutor on a two-wheeler usually copes more easily. Share a landmark and exact directions before the first class. Tutors already teaching in Sector 72 or the tower societies of Sectors 74 and 75 are close enough for regular visits.
Do we pay anything before the first class?

No. The first class is a free demo, and you already know the tutor's hourly fee from the shortlist before you book it. Tutors set their own fees, so compare the two or three matched tutors on teaching and timing as well as price. Switching to another tutor later is free too.

intro: The Noida Expressway zone follows the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway from Sector 92 out to Sector 168. Near its start, Sectors 92, 99, 105 and 108 are plotted sectors of independent houses on authority plots, and Sector 104 mixes towers, floors, offices and Hajipur village. Sectors 93, 93A, 93B, 100 and 107 are mostly gated societies, Sector 110 mixes them with houses and villas, and Sector 128 has township-style campuses. Further out, Sectors 134, 137, 143, 144, 150, 151 and 168 are almost entirely high-rise, with business parks in between, and some towers in Sectors 134 and 151 are still being completed.

The expressway is the obvious route and the worst one at peak hours, crawling both ways once offices close. A tutor from the next sector who can stay on inner roads usually beats one who has to join it. The Aqua Line runs along much of the corridor, with stations at Noida Sector 83, NSEZ and Sector 101 near the start, then Sector 137 and a run of stops from Sector 142 to Sector 148, so a tutor can also ride in. In Sectors 128 and 134 no station is within an easy walk, and inside Sector 150 public transport is still limited.

On NXTutors, tutors for the expressway belt are listed with those living in these sectors first, then tutors who travel to them, then the rest of Noida, then online tutors for specialist boards. Tell us your sector, society and tower, the class, board and subject, and whether a hybrid plan with one home visit a week would suit you. We send two or three matched tutors and show each fee before the demo. The first class is free, at home or online, and if a better-placed tutor turns up later in the year, switching is free.
faqs: Which sectors are on the Noida Expressway belt?

Sectors along the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway from 92 to 168, including 93, 93A, 93B, 99, 100, 104, 105, 107, 108, 110, 128, 134, 137, 143, 144, 150, 151 and 168. Sectors 115 to 122, towards Greater Noida West, form the separate Near Noida Extension zone.
Are the plotted sectors on the expressway different for tuition?

Yes. In Sectors 92, 99, 105 and 108 most families live in independent houses, so a tutor comes straight to the door with no society gate, visitor app or lift. Tutors from neighbouring sectors can reach them on sector roads without joining the expressway, which keeps evening classes on time.
Sectors 150 and 151 feel far out. Can we still get a home tutor?

Yes, but look close to home first. Public transport inside Sector 150 is still limited and Sector 151 is well away from older Noida, so a tutor already teaching in Sectors 149, 150, 152 or nearby expressway sectors is the practical choice. For specialist subjects, online classes with an occasional home visit fill the gap.
How do we compare tutors' fees on NXTutors?

Tutors set their own hourly fee, and each matched tutor's fee is shown before the free demo, so you can weigh price against subject fit and travel. Senior classes and international boards usually cost more than middle-school tuition, and a nearby tutor or a hybrid plan can keep the total down.

intro: Near Noida Extension covers Sectors 115 to 122, the band of Noida that meets Greater Noida West, and mixes three kinds of home. Sectors 118, 119, 120 and 121 are mainly gated apartment societies, some ready and occupied and others still being finished, including a very large complex of more than twenty towers in Sector 120. Sectors 116 and 122 are plotted Noida Authority sectors of houses and builder floors, with many Sector 116 plots still empty. Sector 115 centres on Sorkha village beside the Harit Upvan urban forest, and Sector 117 has authority flats in its abadi pocket alongside newer societies.

Roads decide most arrangements. The Char Murti or Kisan Chowk junction towards Noida Extension carries heavy traffic while underpass work continues, and junctions near the FNG Expressway back up at peak hours, so allow extra time. Metro access is thin: Noida Sector 76 on the Aqua Line is nearest for Sectors 115 and 116, and a station at Sector 122 is only planned on the approved Aqua Line extension. Most tutors therefore come by two-wheeler or cab, and one already teaching in the same cluster keeps a weekly slot most reliably.

For this zone, NXTutors puts tutors who live in Sectors 115 to 122 first, then tutors who travel here, then the rest of Noida, then online tutors. Big societies work in your favour: in a complex of many towers, a tutor who already teaches one family can often add yours on the same evening. Share your sector, society and tower with the class, board and subject when you ask. You receive two or three matched tutors with fees shown in advance, a free first demo, and the option to switch tutor later without charge.
faqs: Which sectors are in the Near Noida Extension zone?

Sectors 115, 116, 117, 118, 119, 120, 121 and 122, close to the Greater Noida West border, with Sector 76 just beyond Sectors 115 and 116. Greater Noida West itself, with Sectors 1 to 16C and Techzone 4, is covered on the Greater Noida zone pages.
Is there a metro near Sectors 115 to 122?

Not inside the zone yet. Noida Sector 76 on the Aqua Line is the nearest station for Sectors 115 and 116, and the approved Aqua Line extension from Sector 51 lists a Sector 122 stop, but it is planned, not open. For now most tutors arrive by two-wheeler, cab or e-rickshaw.
Is home tuition possible in Sorkha village or Sector 116?

Yes. In Sorkha, a tutor usually comes to a village house or builder floor, so share clear directions, because narrow lanes make the first visit tricky. Sector 116 has independent houses on wide roads with many empty plots, so a map pin helps there too. Tutors from Sectors 76, 115 or 117 are the nearest.
What if the tutor cannot keep the slot because of traffic?

Tell us. You can move some classes online with the same tutor, or ask for a new match: switching tutor on NXTutors is free, and each newly shortlisted tutor's fee is shown before you decide. Choosing a tutor from your own cluster of sectors at the start usually avoids the problem.
